intro: The Empty Cleansing Bowl is a ritual vessel given by Thundris Windweaver to aid in investigating the corruption of the Blackwood furbolgs. When filled at the Auberdine moonwell and combined with food samples, it creates a mixture capable of temporarily breaking a satyr's demonic sway.

p: Entrusted to adventurers by Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, the Empty Cleansing Bowl is crafted to carry sacred waters from the local moonwell. The night elves discovered that the northern Blackwood furbolgs fell under demonic madness orchestrated by satyrs, who exert their will through enchanted talismans. By drawing pure lunar water into the bowl and blending it with the furbolgs' harvested nuts, grains, and fruits, the vessel produces a blessed meal that temporarily restores sanity to the afflicted creatures, exposing the satyr overseer responsible.
